trendTitle: Monthly Cost Trend (stacked by provider, currencies side by side)
monthHint: Unique per account+month; saving again overwrites
currencyHint: No FX conversion; currencies are shown side by side in the chart
csvFormat: Each line: month,accountName,amount[,currency][,remark] (account matched by exact name; header line skipped)
csvNote: Rows with the same account+month overwrite existing records.
fetchHint: Calls the provider billing API for the month total and writes it into the ledger (overwrites same account+month); supports Alibaba/Tencent/AWS, enter Huawei manually
